name: h-erp integration
author: hashshop

sections.description:
h-erp integration is a WooCommerce plugin developed by Hashavshevet h-erp®,
The plugin allows Hashavshevet customers, WooCommerce store owners to allow payment in their WooCommerce store through Hashavshevet’s payment service.
After payment, Hashavshevet will generate a receipt tax invoice and send it to the buyer by email.

external service

The plugin uses external services for integration with Hashavshevet.
The service is used for saving an invoice created in Hashavshevet to the WooCommerce store,
and for opening a payment screen for store customers.
The payment is processed through CreditGuard.

Service Link: https://shops-integration.wizcloud.co.il/woocommerce
Terms of Use: https://shops-integration.wizcloud.co.il/woocommerce/terms-conditions
Privacy Policy: https://shops-integration.wizcloud.co.il/woocommerce/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. The settings of the WooCommerce payment page must be changed so that it can work with the “h-erp integration” plugin: Navigate the menu to: Pages > Checkout
  2. Edit the existing checkout page, remove all existing content within the editor and replace it with the [woocommerce_checkout] shortcode. Click “Update” to save the changes.
    This will replace the current content of the payment page with the default WooCommerce payment form.
  3. Install the plugin “h-erp integration” through the WordPress plugins screen.
  4. After following all the instructions and connecting to the service on the Hashavshevet website, the plugin must be activated.
    When the plugin is activated, an API token will be generated in WooCommerce for Hashavshevet.

• Bug fixes.

Version 1.3.2

• Adding a limit on the number of payments to 12.

Version 1.3.3

• Changing the payment field to a select type field.

Version 1.3.4

• Added plugin settings for installments: maximum number of installments (minimum 1) and minimum amount per installment.
• When maximum installments is set to 1, the installments field is hidden (single payment only).
